messages:
Alex M: Heads up — canary run for release-window (2024-04-11T16:00Z) failed at build step for //services/ingest:package. CI shows artifact pull checksum mismatch from S3 cache.
Priya S: yup saw that. restore error says expected sha256:6a1b2..., got sha256:92f4...; s3 object size doesn't match HEAD
Jamal K: could be a multipart reupload collision or a bad promotion. Any recent cache writes to that key?
Alex M: earlier job at 09:12 promoted digest sha256:6a1b2c3d (commit abc1234). Later pushes show different digest. logs:
```
ERROR: cache restore failed: expected sha256:6a1b2c3d, got sha256:92f4e...
key: build-cache/ingest/20240410/part-0001
```
Priya S: other jobs restored the same key OK this morning, so suspect a simultaneous reupload. S3 etag mismatch and multipart parts count differ.
deploy-bot: manual hold applied to release-window 2024-04-11T16:00Z — awaiting triage. @eng-releases please respond.
Alex M: ack. we need to decide: rebuild artifact (45m) or pin to last-green digest to avoid blocking QE window.
Jamal K: pinning seems lower risk for the window. we should prevent full promote and add follow-up for integrity sweep.
Priya S: i'll create ticket INFRA-4567 and attach s3 metadata + object versions; CC @platform-oncall
SREbot: observed pattern: parallel multipart uploads can produce transient corrupt objects if part lists differ. Recommendation: re-upload with single-part, or write to a new key and verify checksums across regions.
Alex M: plan: pin canary -> sha256:6a1b2c3d (commit abc1234) for this rollout; continue canary; block full promote until INFRA-4567 resolved.
Jamal K: deploy-bot, pin canary image/digest and resume canary, please leave promote locked.
deploy-bot: done — canary pinned to sha256:6a1b2c3d, canary resumed. full promote remains blocked. :white_check_mark:
Priya S: i'll follow-up with infra to reupload artifact and run cross-region checksum verify. tagging @eng-infra
Alex M: adding note to release notes: "Canary pinned to last-known-good artifact due to cache integrity issue; full promotion paused pending artifact verification." 
SREbot: incident INC-2024-1887 opened for cache integrity; assigned to @platform-oncall.
Alex M: monitoring canary integration tests now. will abort and revert pin if tests regress. :eyes:
